title: Create: Cars deco
description: Adds several blocks for creating cars (for example, with VS+trackwork)
body:
**Adds 3 blocks for creating cars (for example with VS+trackwork)**
![hood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f65599a87bc72f2a16b1a5ef41705efcd5a7ffe.gif)

![car door](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3122ccebed035ca19dd8d3f11243280052d0f3f.gif)

this mod uses the copycats system so you can give any texture to the blocks.
### blocks:

- horizontal hatch: like vanilla hatch, only horizontal and animated, can be used for a door

- hood (consists of "hood base" and "hood"): to make the hood the shape you want, place "hood base" and "hood" behind it, and click on "hood base"

-  connectable hatch: is a regular hatch with the function of opening simultaneously (prototype of a hood)
